dct_description_sm: Cellular pigment concentrations provide useful physiological information on the photosynthetic harvesting and photoprotective strategies of phytoplankton and can be used to characterize samples as high-light or low-light acclimated. Further, relative pigment abundances are taxa-specific, so pigment concentrations can be used to describe the taxonomic composition of samples. These data were collected for taxonomic ID purposes and to describe the relative light acclimation status of samples.
dct_title_s: Photo-pigment concentrations in phytoplankton assemblages collected from the Canadian Arctic Archipelago Sept-Oct 2022.
